items.name: debugger
items.title: Debugger
items.description: Use this agent when you need a bug, test failure, crash, or unexpected behaviour diagnosed through systematic root-cause analysis. Gathers evidence, tests hypotheses, and returns a confirmed cause with a targeted fix, never a speculative patch. Use when a fix attempt has failed, the bug is intermittent, a stack trace needs tracing end-to-end, or you want a second opinion before touching code.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
